## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; leadership concentration moderate (Top 5 from 3 sectors). Confirmations: broad sector-level participation (10/11 positive) and mixed mega-cap signals — AAPL (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +13.05%) ABOVE TREND vs NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION and GOOGL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY, CEG (1W: +10.06% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary strong: F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND, ROST (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare showing strength: LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials in Weakness: DOW (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -6.54%) BELOW TREND. Industrials/Internal Rotation with pockets of weakness: DE (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -0.95% | 1M: +5.35%) CORRECTION. Energy/Internal Rotation: NEE (1W: -5.15% | 1M: -8.00%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -1.90% | 1M: +3.61%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY, F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND, ROST (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: SBUX (1W: -3.47% | 1M: +4.19%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION, UBER (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -3.86%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION, NEE (1W: -5.15% | 1M: -8.00%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select mega-caps and utilities names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY. Watch for Major Divergence: MSFT (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +0.90%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION — this raises tactical uncertainty despite broad sector participation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: Technology up 1W (1W: +3.08% | 1M: +15.98%) with leaders and fatigue; AAPL (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +13.05%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) ABOVE TREND, but NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION and INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth positive but intra-sector divergence notable.

8. Financials Outlook?
Internal rotation but constructive: JPM (1W: +2.88% | 1M: -1.70%) RECOVERY, V (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +6.70%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +0.88% | 1M: -0.76%) RECOVERY — Financials showing selective strength amid mixed 1M reads.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthy participation: LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +1.60%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +9.56%) CORRECTION is a notable divergence.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective cyclicals and healthcare: F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to names in CORRECTION/BELOW TREND like INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND and NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION until 1W weakness confirms or reverses.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities (1W: +5.17% | 1M: -0.12%) showing rotation into defensive growth of grid/AI power names; Healthcare (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +1.72%) remains constructive. BEARISH: Materials (1W: -0.19% | 1M: -2.64%) and select Industrials names where earnings/guide risk remains.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA for follow-through above/below the recent 1W downtrend to confirm recovery vs extended consolidation; monitor QCOM sustaining multi-week outperformance to confirm tech leadership; monitor INTU for further downside to validate strategic-pivot risk; watch LLY/MRK news flow for catalyst-driven continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+50): Mounjaro confidence from Morgan Stanley; price (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. MRK (+60): CHMP backing Keytruda combo; price (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. VST (+50): AI data-center power deals; price (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY — sentiment supports 1W move but 1M divergence.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
GOOGL (-60): EU fine chatter; price (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION — sentiment aligns with 1W weakness (distribution risk). INTU (-45): workforce cuts and pivot; price (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and a clear risk. META (-45): lawsuit pressures on AI ad model; price (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -7.42%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines align with weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND and QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION and INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND show risk. Key risk is major divergence among mega-caps (MSFT/NVDA/GOOGL patterns) and negative sentiment on INTU/GOOGL that could suppress decisive regime shifts.
